title: Homogeneity of the noise operator
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f\colon\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and let $\rho,c\in\mathbb R$. The Fourier noise operator satisfies $T_\rho(cf)=cT_\rho f$.
replaced: Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$ and $\rho,c\in\bbr$, the Fourier noise operator satisfies $T_\rho(cf)=cT_\rho f$. For $d\in\mathbb N$, $h:\{0,1\}^d\to\bbr$, and $\tau\in\bbr$, the spectral noise operator is $T_\tau h(x)=\sum_{S\subseteq[d]}\tau^{|S|}\widehat h(S)\chi_S(x)$, where $\chi_S(x)=(-1)^{\sum_{i\in S}x_i}$ and $\widehat h(S)=\E[h\chi_S]$ under the uniform measure.
